WITH eligible_winners AS (
    SELECT ma.player_id, p.bats
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
), hand_counts AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN bats IS NULL OR TRIM(bats) = '' THEN '' ELSE bats END AS hand,
           COUNT(*) AS winner_count
    FROM eligible_winners
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN bats IS NULL OR TRIM(bats) = '' THEN '' ELSE bats END
)
SELECT hand,
       winner_count,
       1.0 * winner_count / SUM(winner_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM hand_counts;
